name: TDF Crosses Tekeze River Into Tselemt
detail: Tigray Defense Forces units crossed the Tekeze River into disputed Tselemti woreda, triggering clashes with federal forces on Jan 26, 28, and 29, the opening move of the 2026 crisis.

name: TDF Captures Alamata and Korem
detail: Tigrayan forces captured Alamata and Korem in southern Tigray after the federal command post in the area withdrew.

name: OLA Claimed Operation Near Addis Ababa
detail: OLA claimed killing 256 ENDF troops, wounding 179, and capturing 122 in an operation within ~100km of Addis Ababa; figures unverified.

name: Fano Contests Bahir Dar Approach Roads
detail: Fano militias sustained offensives across northern Amhara, contesting the B22 and B31 roads leading to regional capital Bahir Dar.

name: TPLF Reconstitutes Tigray Regional Council
detail: The TPLF reconvened the pre-war Tigray State Council and elected Debretsion Gebremichael regional president, rejecting the federally-extended interim administration.

name: Coordinated Attacks on Teleta Gebriel
detail: Attacks beginning May 30 in Aseko district, East Arsi Zone, killed at least 37 Orthodox Christians and continued through the June 1 election.

name: Fano Fighting Across 64 Woredas in Election Week
detail: Fano and government forces clashed in more than 64 woreda/city administrations across 12 Amhara zones during the June 1-7 election week.

name: TPLF Engagement at Shererina
detail: TPLF's 'Army 70' unit, reportedly based across the border in Sudan, engaged federal forces near Shererina in an ~11-hour battle involving drones and heavy artillery.
